Name: Cetiri's Raincrows for CP and AT
Author: AtomicBunnytron
Description:
The majestic Heehoo Bird has graced your farm.
They are not merely painted crows!! How rude! They slave over a hot perch just to keep your crops safe, you know! They even threw out those old stuffed effigies you called "scarecrows", and they expected nothing in return for this service.
Regardless, you may rest safe with your crops under the watchful gaze of these trustworthy rainbow birds.
Now with more original goose-like features! Same great taste with brand new packaging! Wow!!


Thank you to the other mods that I looked at to get a better understanding of how to safely json in my own home, I think I might even understand a little of what I'm looking at now!


We have a few versions available, the original matchy-matchy crow recolor now sits in the old downloads for those who prefer them.
Here are the traits of our available specimens:


Standard - She's not sure what she's into, yet. There are an awful lot of choices!
Deluxe - Honestly, this isn't even his main job. When you're not looking, who knows what he does?


Rarecrow 1 - This is a spicy bird. Does he eat them, or just admire the color?
Rarecrow 2 - Aw yeah, beach berd! Just look at that tan.
Rarecrow 3 - Wants to be a novelty toilet roll dispenser, but has not grasped that the paper rolls *over*, not *under*.
Rarecrow 4 - Nobody likes to be alone, and so this bird has become an adoptive parent.
Rarecrow 5 - He's either been hitting the sauce or hitting Pam's garbage bin.
Rarecrow 6 - This little artist has been getting into the DIY scene. She's still learning.
Rarecrow 7 - She likes flowers! Who doesn't?
Rarecrow 8 - This one's clearly got a sweet tooth (beak?), as she's gotten berry juice everywhere...


AT Bonus 1 - This fella is trying to live his pastel dream fantasy. Perhaps you should introduce him to Haley?
AT Bonus 2 - Poor thing can't read, it's anyone's best guess what he thinks the dynamite is.
AT Bonus 3 - She's trying to grow a beanstalk tall enough to reach the heavens! Unfortunately, it is only a weed.
AT Bonus 4 - A skilled enchantress, really! What do you mean that's not your card?!
